description: This is a PHP class file defining the DropDownBrowser class, which manages and displays dropdown options within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder interface, specifically for restricted dropdowns and dynamically generating nodes for dropdowns in the UI.

classes.name: DropDownBrowser
classes.description: A class providing functionality to list dropdown options for the ModuleBuilder UI, with restrictions.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Method that compiles and returns an array of dropdown nodes for UI display, filtered against restricted dropdowns.
